title: Copperbound
description: This mod makes copper actually usefull, adding copper tools and armor.
body:
# Copperbound: A Meaningful Early-Game Upgrade!
### Adds a balanced copper tier to your Minecraft experience.
- Copper Tools: Better than stone for early resource gathering.
- Copper Armor: Provides a solid step up in protection.
- Copper Weapons: Bridges the gap between stone and iron.
### Features balanced stats:
- Enchantability: 12
- Sword Damage: 5.5
- Axe Damage: 7
- Sword Attack Speed: 1.6
- Axe Attack Speed: 0.9 (Faster than stone)
- Efficiency: 4.5!
